schemas.name: C03_Netlist_Freeze.json
schemas.notes: WP1/DD-05. The freeze record promoted to the stage root alongside C03_<product>.net. Tracked in version control; its absence beside an existing .net is C03_NETLIST_FREEZE_MISSING.

fields.name: product
fields.notes: product slug; matches the C03_<product>.net filename

fields.name: frozen_at
fields.notes: when the freeze was taken

fields.name: emitting_revision
fields.notes: engine revision that produced the .net files (git sha or container rev)

fields.name: entries
fields.notes: one per emitted .net; an empty array is the `empty` outcome, not a pass

fields.name: fidelity_verdict
fields.notes: the bodesign_verify_netlist_fidelity status recorded at freeze time: ok | failed | not-run | indeterminate. Anything other than ok makes the freeze check fail.

schemas.name: FreezeEntry
schemas.notes: WP1/DD-05. One emitted netlist file inside C03_Netlist_Freeze.json.entries.

fields.name: path
fields.notes: path of the emitted .net relative to the stage root

fields.name: sha256
fields.notes: digest of the file at freeze time; a mismatch on disk is C03_NETLIST_FREEZE_STALE

fields.name: nets_parsed
fields.notes: net blocks parsed from this file; 0 makes the freeze check fail rather than pass

schemas.name: verify_netlist_fidelity.input
schemas.notes: WP4 MCP verb input. The spec schema carries inner field descriptions — the RCA section 3-F defect was an opaque {type: object}.

fields.name: spec
fields.notes: the expected partition; each key is a net name, each value a list of [ref, pin] pairs

fields.name: emitted
fields.notes: paths of KiCad .net exports; nets of the same name on different sheets are merged by shared node

fields.name: nc_declared
fields.notes: pins the spec declares no-connect; a declared pin found with peers lands in nc_wired and is excluded from fused

schemas.name: verify_netlist_fidelity.output
schemas.notes: WP4 MCP verb output. Five difference fields stay independent because their fixes differ; status never reaches ok from an unread input (DD-06).

fields.name: status
fields.notes: exit 0 for ok, 1 for failed, 2 for not-run and indeterminate

fields.name: nets_parsed
fields.notes: 0 forces indeterminate before any comparison runs

fields.name: fused
fields.notes: nodes that gained peers only — short / fusion; NC-declared pins excluded

fields.name: split
fields.notes: nodes that lost peers only — open circuit

fields.name: node_diff
fields.notes: nodes present on one side only, singleton exemptions applied symmetrically and reported

fields.name: nc_wired
fields.notes: declared-NC pins the emitter connected to something; new in WP4 — fidelity.py has zero nc_ occurrences today

fields.name: unreadable_paths
fields.notes: emitted paths that could not be read or parsed; non-empty forces indeterminate. Replaces the swallowing continue at fidelity.py:220

schemas.name: design_suggest.output
schemas.notes: WP5 MCP verb output. committed is not a member of the status codomain, so no input can produce it (DD-02 property 1).

fields.name: status
fields.notes: no-rule means no KB anchor covered the pin class; indeterminate means a rule applied but its input or window did not resolve

fields.name: suggestions
fields.notes: topology + values; empty whenever status is not suggested

fields.name: evidence
fields.notes: attached to every numeric value; a value without kb_object cannot be emitted

fields.name: review_required
fields.notes: asserted by test for every input in the matrix, not merely set by convention (DD-02 property 2)

schemas.name: readability_gate.report
schemas.notes: WP6 output. gate_axis and does_not_authorize are report FIELDS, not prose, so an aggregator cannot drop them by reformatting (DD-07).

fields.name: status
fields.notes: not-run when route_stats is absent; indeterminate when route_stats disagrees with the emitted drawing

fields.name: gate_axis
fields.notes: names the axis this verdict belongs to

fields.name: does_not_authorize
fields.notes: emitted on pass and fail alike

fields.name: measurements
fields.type: object {junctions, stub_share, wired_nets, labelled_nets, antifusion_downgrades, drawn_fragments}
fields.notes: projected from route_stats; each compared against a threshold citing its BR_20260905 section 8.5 line

fields.name: corpus
fields.notes: which spec was scored; thresholds are scale-dependent, so a synthetic corpus may supplement but never decide (BR_20260905 section 8.5.5)

schemas.name: gate.py --list envelope (packages disclosure)
schemas.notes: WP3. Fields already exist at gate.py:845-861; WP3 extends resolution, not the disclosure shape.

fields.name: packages_resolved
fields.notes: true proves only that packages/workflow-core resolved as a directory — not that any verb will run (gate.py:849)

fields.name: packages_root
fields.notes: which candidate answered; new information under DD-04's enumerated tier

fields.name: packages_error
fields.notes: verbatim LandingError; no fallback attempted on failure
